edges.reason: Constructor invokes _mint to create the initial supply for the deployer.
initialBalance_ flows into the mint amount within the constructor.
Constructor mints to _msgSender(), derived from msg.sender.
Constructor chains the payable ServicePayer base constructor.
Base constructor calls the external IPayable.pay with forwarded value, enabling callback execution before state finalization.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender of _transfer.
transferFrom reads _msgSender() for the spender allowance lookup.
transfer delegates value movement to _transfer.
transferFrom performs the balance movement via _transfer.
transferFrom updates the remaining allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_mint credits the recipient entry of _balances.
_burn debits the account entry of _balances.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
transferFrom assigns the caller allowance into local currentAllowance.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount before re-approving.
The subtraction result is passed as the new allowance to _approve.
_transfer loads the sender balance into local senderBalance.
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount when debiting the sender.
_mint performs unchecked-style addition on _totalSupply.
_burn loads the account balance into local accountBalance.
amount parameter flows into the internal _transfer balance math.
sender parameter flows into the internal _transfer balance lookup.
recipient parameter flows into the internal _transfer balance credit.
spender parameter flows into the _approve allowance write.

normalization_plan.reason: Parser-level parameter of the constructor that only feeds the initial mint amount.
Transfer amount parameter directly bound to the _transfer arithmetic core operation.
Source address parameter directly bound to the _transfer balance update.
Destination address parameter directly bound to the _transfer credit.
Allowance beneficiary parameter directly bound to the _approve state write.
Temporary local only used within transferFrom for the allowance subtraction.
Temporary local only used within _transfer for the sender debit math.
Temporary local only used within _burn for the burn balance validation.
